## Goal
Export confirmed expenses as CSV, publish the OpenAPI spec, and list expenses in the UI.

**Depends on:** F05, F06
**Built by:** `backend-dev` ∥ `frontend-dev`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The CSV columns match `contracts/csv-export.md`
- [ ] `docs/openapi.json` is exported and up to date
- [ ] `expenses.html` lists expenses with the documented filters, deletes one (`DELETE /expenses/{id}`) and downloads the CSV (moved from F06, decision 0018)
